display.name: Cormorant Garamond
display.locator: brand-specified family; local proof files available in ../fonts/CormorantGaramond-400.ttf, ../fonts/CormorantGaramond-500.ttf, and ../fonts/CormorantGaramond-600.ttf
display.rationale: The brand display family is retained but deliberately reduced for Direction B: it appears as compressed editorial interrupts and pull-lines rather than the main section headline voice.

body.name: Inter
body.locator: brand-specified family; local proof files available in ../fonts/Inter-400.ttf, ../fonts/Inter-500.ttf, ../fonts/Inter-600.ttf, and ../fonts/Inter-700.ttf
body.rationale: The brand body family becomes Direction B's primary display, index, CTA, and navigation family so the page reads as a clinical decision atlas rather than an editorial consult ledger.

h1.rationale: Large Inter headlines create the declarative atlas voice and visibly invert Direction A's Cormorant-led hierarchy.

h2.rationale: Section headlines stay analytical and direct, supporting fast physician self-orientation.

body.rationale: Explanatory copy needs crisp clinical readability and compliance clarity.

utility.rationale: Indices, rail labels, captions, proof labels, and professional-role annotations use Inter for precise scanning.

cta.rationale: CTA labels are decisive without urgency and remain the only elements that read as actionable controls.

editorial_interrupt.rationale: Cormorant Garamond is reserved for compact pull-lines and brief editorial notes, never the dominant B headline structure.

frames.type_scale_relation: Largest Inter headline on the page; compact Cormorant interrupt only near the evidence panel, with CTAs and proof line in Inter.

ornaments.anchor: top and bottom navy framing with lower-right decision ticks beside the hero atlas plates
ornaments.responsive: Reduce to short edge ticks and one lower-right decision point on mobile while preserving CTA hierarchy.
ornaments.rationale: Introduces coordination as atlas calibration rather than a cinematic flowing line.

frames.type_scale_relation: Short strip uses medium Inter headline and compact signal labels; no Cormorant headline or numbered station labels.

ornaments.anchor: sloped tick rail running through four staggered career signals and exiting at lower center
ornaments.responsive: Stack career signals vertically with unlabeled ticks and tiny gold points; do not introduce decorative numbers.
ornaments.rationale: Shows career movement as calibration, not a product timeline.

frames.type_scale_relation: Large Inter explanatory headline balances compact Inter role labels; Cormorant is absent or limited to a small orientation interrupt.

ornaments.anchor: central Your priorities island with five irregular role islands and bottom-left rail exit
ornaments.responsive: Role islands stack around the priorities island with dashed path hints; boundary note remains visible.
ornaments.rationale: Explains fragmentation without literal rooms or credential claims.

frames.type_scale_relation: Inter headline and phase labels support a radial process instrument; the only large numerals are the functional 01-06 phase numbers.

ornaments.anchor: six clipped phase plates orbiting nested rings, entering from 03 and exiting lower right
ornaments.responsive: Convert the radial instrument to a compact vertical process while preserving only the six functional phase numbers.
ornaments.rationale: Makes the Wealth Blueprint memorable without using A's horizontal journey line.

frames.type_scale_relation: Quiet Inter headline and discipline labels sit inside a vertical register with smaller body summaries and one tiny Cormorant pull-line.

ornaments.anchor: left-edge tick system and stepped mist columns exiting at lower left
ornaments.responsive: Stack the discipline register as stepped blocks with no decorative numbers or icons.
ornaments.rationale: Preserves interdependence while avoiding a horizontal ledger table.

frames.type_scale_relation: Inter headline and pathway labels pair with caption-like Inter summaries in a hard-edged contact sheet; Cormorant is not needed.

ornaments.anchor: upper-left rail through five hard-edged medical crops and out lower right
ornaments.responsive: Keep the contact-sheet captions attached to crops and use the rail as an index, not a button group.
ornaments.rationale: Lets visitors locate their medical context through evidence panels rather than keyword-swapped cards.

frames.type_scale_relation: Medium Inter headline, Inter credential strip, and precise Inter body copy sit in a clipped dossier; Cormorant does not drive the section.

ornaments.anchor: dossier registration marks around neutral portrait slot and credential evidence panel
ornaments.responsive: Portrait slot remains neutral and credentials stay as text, never badges or seals.
ornaments.rationale: Connects accountability to the verified planner without personality-brand spectacle.

frames.type_scale_relation: Large Inter closing headline and Inter decision labels sit on navy; small Cormorant interrupt is limited to the calibration line under the headline.

ornaments.anchor: upper-center decision point splitting into two dotted calibrated paths and footer rail
ornaments.responsive: Stack the two decision plates with the guide availability warning directly under the guide path.
ornaments.rationale: Closes with two honest next actions without A's sweeping split line.

context_checks: Inter carries the large hero, section, CTA, and atlas index roles.
Cormorant Garamond is visible only as restrained editorial interrupts.
All eight frames are represented in the proof strip.
No substitute font families are approved.

art_director_rationale: Direction B uses the same brand families as Direction A but reverses their hierarchy: Inter becomes the decisive clinical atlas voice, while Cormorant Garamond is held back for small moments of warmth and editorial restraint.
builder_freedom: The builder may tune exact font sizes and clamp values if Inter remains dominant and Cormorant remains sparse.
The builder may simplify ornament density on mobile while preserving rails, ticks, and decision points.
The builder must keep the functional phase numbers only in the Blueprint section and avoid decorative folio numbering elsewhere.
